author: kirubaharan181
description: Operates cloud compute, storage, network, DR and cost. Use when managing hosted infrastructure. Do NOT use for pipelines or app changes.
purpose: Keeps hosted infrastructure available, recoverable and cost-aware: compute, databases, storage, DNS, certificates, networks, backups, disaster recovery, high availability, scaling, cost and maintenance. It owns stages 140-152.
when_to_use: Cloud resources need managing, patching or right-sizing.
Backups, disaster recovery or high availability must be designed or tested.
Certificates, DNS or network operations need controlled change.
when_not_to_use: Monitoring and alert design: use sre-observability.
prerequisites: Cloud account access at the least privilege needed.
No external API keys, paid services or network access are required; work uses files and tools already approved in the repository.
outputs: disaster recovery and failover test results
certificate and DNS inventories with expiry

decision_rules.action: Report and assign before any change.
Schedule a restore test before relying on it.
Size from baseline usage and require the budget owner's approval.
Require human approval under the approval policy.

quality_gates: Restores were tested against recovery objectives
Cost actions have estimates and owners

examples.title: Test a restore
examples.request: Verify we can restore the orders database.
examples.behavior: Restore the latest backup to a scratch instance, run row-count checks, and time the process.
examples.output: Restore record: completed in 38 minutes, counts match source.
examples.acceptance: Measured time and loss are compared with the objectives.

examples.title: Find idle spend
examples.behavior: List idle resources with owners, propose schedules, and estimate savings with assumptions.
examples.output: Action list with owner confirmation steps and estimated saving.
examples.acceptance: No resource is stopped without owner confirmation.

limitations: Cannot act on accounts it cannot reach; it lists the commands to run.
Cost figures depend on provider prices and usage that change.
Destructive and production actions need human approval.

troubleshooting.resolution: Request read access; do not use broader credentials.
Treat as an incident risk, fix the backup process and retest.
Replace now and add staged expiry alerts.
